instruction: Set Garamond as the default standard font and Arial Black as the default heading font in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Garamond as standard font and Arial Black as heading font in LibreOffice Writer. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify both Standard and Heading font names. Partial credit: 0.5 for each correct font.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct standard font (Garamond), 0.5 for correct heading font (Arial Black)

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks both font requirements (standard and heading fonts)
Getter logic correctly extracts font settings from LibreOffice config file at /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont
Metric correctly compares both fonts with expected values and provides appropriate partial credit (0.5 for each match)
Expected parameter handling is correct - metric directly accesses expected.get('standard_font') and expected.get('heading_font') as the rules dictionary
Complete coverage of instruction requirements - both standard font (Garamond) and heading font (Arial Black) are verified
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to close LibreOffice Writer or trigger a settings save to ensure registrymodifications.xcu file is updated before evaluation
The config file may not be immediately updated while LibreOffice is running, which could cause the getter to read stale data
